name: How much does a front door replacement cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a front door replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a front door replacement varies widely depending on several factors, such as the material (fiberglass, steel, wood), style, size, glass inserts, hardware choices, and installation complexity. Custom doors or those with advanced security features will typically be at the higher end of the spectrum. It's best to get a detailed estimate from a contractor to understand the total investment for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Front door replacement costs vary based on material, style, size, and installation complexity.
